facts.fact: Law 25-11 of 24 July 2025, published in the Journal Officiel that day, adds article 45 bis 13 to Law 18-07, under which the competent authority assesses the adequate level of protection in a foreign State or international organisation before data are transferred there, for transfers for criminal-justice purposes, and allows transfer on insufficient safeguards only in listed cases (vital interests, public security threat, individual criminal cases); the document gives as_of as its publication date and states no separate entry-into-force date.
facts.system: Loi n° 25-11 modifiant et complétant la loi n° 18-07 (art. 45 bis 13)

facts.fact: Article 45 bis 14, added by the same law of 24 July 2025, bars onward transfer of data received from a foreign State or organisation to another State unless the sending State or organisation has first accepted it, with an exception for the State's fundamental interests or a grave and immediate public-security threat.
facts.system: Loi n° 25-11 modifiant et complétant la loi n° 18-07 (art. 45 bis 14)
